ci.text: saani/ci: full run on the PC, 40%

roster.name: Coder
roster.what: writes the change for one issue in its own worktree

roster.name: Tester
roster.what: runs the tests and says what a failure means

roster.name: Reviewer
roster.what: reviews the diff with fresh eyes

roster.name: Sentinel
roster.what: server diagnostics with a read-only key

roster.name: Deployer
roster.what: deploys production after the owner's tap

roster.name: Explore
roster.file: built into Claude Code (no file in the repo)

roster.name: Plan
roster.file: built into Claude Code (no file in the repo)

signals.title: Issue
signals.from: the issue: open, or closed and why

signals.title: Worktree and branch
signals.from: the worktrees and worker branches, the test queue and the Claude Code sessions on this PC

signals.title: Live checks
signals.from: the issue's title and milestone, and the other issues of that milestone

signals.title: GitHub status
signals.from: the issue's GitHub status and its category (not read on a repo without statuses)

signals.title: Git
signals.from: the commits `refs #n` on `dev` that `main` does not have yet

signals.title: Release pull request
signals.from: the open `dev` -> `main` pull request (its commits and description)

signals.title: Saani's log
signals.from: the structured log of the stage changes (#128): not read yet

places.name: Wayfarers' Tents
rows: not the live checks of a released milestone
no status, Backlog, Done or Not planned or Duplicate
places.next: You set its status to Todo (or, without statuses, give it a milestone): it moves to The Granary.

places.name: The Granary
rows: not the live checks of a released milestone
Todo, In progress or In review
places.next: `saani start <n>`, or an auto run, creates its worktree and branch: it moves to The Workshops.

places.name: Council Rock
rows: none, a Claude session on it (no worktree) or an empty worktree (just started)
not the live checks of a released milestone
places.next: You answer and remove the label: it goes back to where its work stands (The Granary or The Workshops).

places.name: The Workshops
rows: a worktree with commits not landed or edits not committed, an empty worktree (just started) or a Claude session on it (no worktree)
In progress, In review or no status
places.next: Committed and tests started (`saani test`, `saani land`): Proving Ground. Landed: Caravan Depot.

places.name: Proving Ground
rows: tests running in its worktree (`saani test`), or the final check of `saani land`
places.note: Tests running win over every other signal.
places.next: Green: The Loading Yard. A failure: back to The Workshops.

places.name: The Loading Yard
rows: a clean worktree whose landing tests are green for this very commit
places.next: `saani land` merges it into `dev`: Caravan Depot. A new commit resets the tests: back to The Workshops.

places.name: Caravan Depot
rows: none, a Claude session on it (no worktree) or an empty worktree (just started)
not the live checks of a released milestone
In progress, In review or no status
not carried by an open release pull request
places.next: The release pull request `dev` -> `main` names it: The Refinery.

places.name: The Refinery
rows: none, a Claude session on it (no worktree) or an empty worktree (just started)
not the live checks of a released milestone
In progress, In review or no status
carried by the open release pull request (`refs #n` or `Closes #n`)
places.note: The beacon is that pull request's CI: green, red, or yellow while it runs. Without an open pull request this place is empty.
places.next: `saani merge` merges it into `main`: the issues it `Closes` are closed, the others get `in-main`.

places.name: Launch Pad
rows: none, a Claude session on it (no worktree) or an empty worktree (just started)
not the live checks of a released milestone
In progress, In review, no status or Done
something to deploy (a commit changes a file under `[deploy] paths`, or the project sets no paths)
places.next: `saani deploy` removes `in-main`: a closed issue moves to The Citadel.

places.name: The Archive
rows: none, a Claude session on it (no worktree) or an empty worktree (just started)
not the live checks of a released milestone
In progress, In review, no status or Done
nothing to deploy: none of its commits changes a file under `[deploy] paths`
places.next: You close it, citing the merge commit: it moves to The Citadel.

places.name: The Far Outpost
rows: none, a Claude session on it (no worktree) or an empty worktree (just started)
an open issue titled "Live checks ..." whose milestone's release is merged: every other issue of the milestone is closed or labelled `in-main`, and, with a `[deploy] command`, none is still To deploy
places.note: The live checks of a released milestone win over the issue's labels and status. Before the release the issue stays in its normal place.
places.next: You walk through the checklist on the live system and close the issue: it moves to The Citadel.

places.name: The Citadel
rows: closed as completed or closed as not planned or as a duplicate
none, a Claude session on it (no worktree) or an empty worktree (just started)
places.note: Closed in the last 7 days; the done issues of closed milestones are left out.

wins: Labelled `idea` with no worktree: not on the map at all.

First the facts, in this order, each keeping the places that fit it: the worktree and branch (tests running: Proving Ground; landing tests green: The Loading Yard; commits or edits: The Workshops), the live checks of a released milestone (The Far Outpost), the issue's state (closed: The Citadel, or Launch Pad), the labels `help wanted` and `owner-action` (Council Rock).

Then the signals in the order of trust: GitHub status, then Git, then Labels (`[pipeline]` in saani.toml). A signal that fits none of the places left is set aside: it contradicts the place, which is then probable, not sure.
Then the release pull request (The Refinery or Caravan Depot), the deploy (Launch Pad or The Archive) and, without GitHub statuses, the milestone (The Granary or the Wayfarers' Tents).

Of the places left, the first of: Proving Ground, The Loading Yard, The Far Outpost, The Citadel, The Archive, Launch Pad, The Refinery, Caravan Depot, Council Rock, The Workshops, The Granary, Wayfarers' Tents.
